what: Hovering a name or link opens a 240×320 portrait photo window 20px beside the cursor — the outer panel slides in from −100%·−100% and the inner photo from 100%·100%, in opposite directions, settling in .4s (opening as if wiped diagonally), on release the outer panel exits to the bottom right and the inner photo to the top left in .3s, closing it. The window follows the cursor, and with tint set it copies the link’s data-tint onto that ancestor (the footer) to tint the background with the photo’s main color. With gate set, it opens only when that ancestor is more than 90% visible

options.side: Window position — below-right (default, lower right of cursor) · below-left · above-right · above-left
options.ease: Curve — default power1.out (power5.out, which the original lists, doesn’t exist in GSAP so the default curve runs)
options.click: If keep, pressing leaves the window open. By default it closes the window the moment it is pressed (as with a next-post button when the page changes)
options.tint: Ancestor CSS that carries the link’s data-tint over — the consuming CSS is [data-tint=n] sets a background color and a background-color transition
options.gate · ratio: Opens only when this ancestor CSS is visible beyond ratio (default .9)
options.[data-fx-part=pic]: Photo slot (child) to float in the window — usually hidden, then moved into the window

use: Artist Name

from.where: shared.js footer person names (below-right, tint·gate footer, click keep) · about.html contact email (below-left) · detail.html next post button (above-right) — original hover-reveal 240×320, outer −100% · inner 100% diagonal .4s/.3s
